propositions: The existing coverage collection step in _build-and-test.yml must emit coverage.xml via --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml on the ubuntu+3.13 cell only, reusing the same coverage session with no additional test runs.
A new report-only diff-cover step must run on the Gerrit Verified lane (when inputs.gerrit-refspec is set) to compare coverage against HEAD^ and report changed-line coverage to the job step summary.
The diff-cover step must be non-blocking (--fail-under=0) and skip gracefully on non-Gerrit lanes and when coverage.xml does not exist.
The gerrit refspec must be passed via environment variable (GERRIT_REFSPEC) to the run block rather than direct template interpolation, and all zizmor, ruff, and actionlint checks must pass.

The _COVERAGE_FLAGS constant and its regex matcher and both embeddings in _render_default_suite_body must be updated to include --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml, with test_ci_workflow_parity.py verifying all three locations.
